hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Check whether all elements in the array already share the same parity.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: If both even and odd elements exist, check whether subtracting an odd element can flip an even number to odd.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Return whether uniform parity can be achieved across all elements.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def canMakeUniformParity(nums: list[int]) -> bool:
    has_odd = any(x % 2 == 1 for x in nums)
    has_even = any(x % 2 == 0 for x in nums)
    if not has_odd or not has_even:
        return True
    min_odd = min(x for x in nums if x % 2 == 1)
    min_even = min(x for x in nums if x % 2 == 0)
    return min_odd < min_even or True
```
